articles.title: SEC filing: 8-K — Fermi Inc. (CURRENT REPORT)
articles.summary: Fermi Inc. disclosed the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, where neither of the two Class I director nominees received the required majority of outstanding shares to be elected, but they will continue to serve due to the company's bylaws. The meeting also resulted in the ratification of Ernst Young LLP as the company's independent auditors, with over 492 million votes in favor. The company is reserving its rights regarding a potential breach of a director nomination agreement related to the voting for one of the director nominees, Governor Perry.

articles.title: SEC filing: 8-K — Fermi Inc. (CURRENT REPORT)
articles.summary: Fermi Inc. announced that its subsidiaries entered into a Limited Waiver and Amendment No. 1 to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd., eliminating a covenant that required the company to enter into a lease or offtake arrangement for 400 MW on the Project Matador site by November 10, 2026. This amendment is expected to eliminate potential required principal payments of approximately $22 million in the fourth quarter of 2026, $19 million in the first quarter of 2027, and $15 million in the second quarter of 2027. The company paid amendment fees totaling $25 million in connection with the agreement.
